route_summary: Low-f primes are identity-poor: the size-normalized bottom 2% is 98% inside Mordell's six QR classes mod 840 (p ~ 1e-110). Proving the mechanism is the open line.

attempts.one_line: Twelve machine-verified identity families cover 834/840 classes mod 840; the uncovered six are exactly the squares of units, reproducing Mordell's bound.
The class-601 anomaly from 001 is small-sample noise; the real signal is QR-class identity-poverty, with class mean f monotone in covering-family count (r=0.92).
attempts.methodological_lesson: f(p) grows with p, so bottom-by-raw-f selection re-measures small primes. Rank within dyadic bands. This flaw produced 001's false positive.
